mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate near zero (0.06%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.06%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 270 (1982-1984=100) signals persistent inflation, which increases the risk of central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 270), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and industrial production rises above 100.0 (2017=100), it signals an overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE<4.0 AND INDPRO>100.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by CPIAUCSL > 270 and INDPRO > 100.0), persistent inflation and strong economic growth increase the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances in the late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL>270 AND INDPRO>100.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1600.0 (thousands of units) signals strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of a robust economy and may lead to expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST>1600.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
